verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
verses.pt: Tem misericórdia de mim, ó Deus, conforme a tua bondade; desfaz minhas transgressões conforme a abundância de tuas misericórdias.
verses.en_web: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David. When Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bath-sheba.> Have pity on me, O God, in your mercy; out of a full heart, take away my sin.

verses.en: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
verses.pt: Lava-me bem de minha perversidade, e purifica-me de meu pecado.
verses.en_web: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.
verses.en_bbe: Let all my wrongdoing be washed away, and make me clean from evil.

verses.en: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.
verses.pt: Porque eu reconheço minhas transgressões, e meu pecado está continuamente diante de mim.
verses.en_web: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.
verses.en_bbe: For I am conscious of my error; my sin is ever before me.

verses.en: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.
verses.pt: Contra ti, somente contra ti pequei, e fiz o mal segundo teus olhos; para que estejas justo no que dizeres, e puro no que julgares.
verses.en_web: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight; that you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.
verses.en_bbe: Against you, you only, have I done wrong, working that which is evil in your eyes; so that your words may be seen to be right, and you may be clear when you are judging.

verses.en: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
verses.pt: Eis que em perversidade fui formado, e em pecado minha mãe me concebeu.
verses.en_web: Behold, I was born in iniquity. In sin my mother conceived me.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, I was formed in evil, and in sin did my mother give me birth.

verses.en: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.
verses.pt: Eis que tu te agradas da verdade interior, e no oculto tu me fazes conhecer sabedoria.
verses.en_web: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
verses.en_bbe: Your desire is for what is true in the inner parts: in the secrets of my soul you will give me knowledge of wisdom.

verses.en: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
verses.pt: Limpa-me do pecado com hissopo, e ficarei limpo; lava-me, e eu serei mais branco que a neve.
verses.en_web: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
verses.en_bbe: Make me free from sin with hyssop: let me be washed whiter than snow.

verses.en: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
verses.pt: Faça-me ouvir alegria e contentamento, e meus ossos, que tu quebraste, se alegrarão.
verses.en_web: Let me hear joy and gladness, That the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
verses.en_bbe: Make me full of joy and rapture; so that the bones which have been broken may be glad.

verses.en: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
verses.pt: Esconde tua face de meus pecados, e desfaz todas as minhas perversidades.
verses.en_web: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.
verses.en_bbe: Let your face be turned from my wrongdoing, and take away all my sins.

verses.en: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
verses.pt: Cria em mim um coração puro, ó Deus; e renova um espírito firme em meu interior.
verses.en_web: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
verses.en_bbe: Make a clean heart in me, O God; give me a right spirit again.

verses.en: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
verses.pt: Não me rejeites de tua face, e não tires teu Espírito Santo de mim.
verses.en_web: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your holy Spirit from me.
verses.en_bbe: Do not put me away from before you, or take your holy spirit from me.

verses.en: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
verses.pt: Restaura a alegria de tua salvação, e que tu me sustentes com um espírito de boa vontade.
verses.en_web: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
verses.en_bbe: Give me back the joy of your salvation; let a free spirit be my support.

verses.en: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.
verses.pt: Então eu ensinarei aos transgressores os teus caminhos, e os pecadores se converterão a ti.
verses.en_web: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners shall be converted to you.
verses.en_bbe: Then will I make your ways clear to wrongdoers; and sinners will be turned to you.

verses.en: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
verses.pt: Livra-me das transgressões por derramamento de sangue, ó Deus, Deus de minha salvação; e minha língua louvará alegremente tua justiça.
verses.en_web: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue shall sing aloud of your righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: Be my saviour from violent death, O God, the God of my salvation; and my tongue will give praise to your righteousness.

verses.en: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.
verses.pt: Abre, Senhor, os meus lábios, e minha boca anunciará louvor a ti.
verses.en_web: Lord, open my lips. My mouth shall declare your praise.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, let my lips be open, so that my mouth may make clear your praise.

verses.en: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.
verses.pt: Porque tu não te agradas de sacrifícios, pois senão eu te daria; tu não te alegras de holocaustos.
verses.en_web: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.
verses.en_bbe: You have no desire for an offering or I would give it; you have no delight in burned offerings.

verses.en: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
verses.pt: Os sacrifícios a Deus são um espírito quebrado em arrependimento; tu não desprezarás um coração quebrado e triste.
verses.en_web: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. A broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.
verses.en_bbe: The offerings of God are a broken spirit; a broken and sorrowing heart, O God, you will not put from you.

verses.en: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Faze bem a Sião conforme tua boa vontade; edifica os muros de Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: Do good to Zion in your good pleasure, building up the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.en: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
verses.pt: Então tu te agradarás dos sacrifícios de justiça, dos holocaustos, e das ofertas queimadas; então oferecerão bezerros sobre teu altar. Instrução de Davi, para o regente, quando Doegue, o edomita, veio, e contou a Saul, dizendo: Davi veio à casa de Aimeleque:
verses.en_web: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.
verses.en_bbe: Then you will have delight in the offerings of righteousness, in burned offerings and offerings of beasts; then they will make offerings of oxen on your altar.
